design.reference: independent continuous-time affine-generator RK4 and analytic CIR/log-return moments
design.variance_comparison: max(auxiliary terminal variance, 0); raw auxiliary state retained for continuation
design.coupling: sum fine Brownian increments; identical observation-level Poisson counts and jump normals
design.acceptance: finest-grid errors <= budget + 5 MC SE; last paired refinement changes satisfy same rule; ODE refinement passes
design.limits: diagnostic pilot, not simultaneous confidence bounds or a proof of a discretization-bias bound; no posterior, pricing, market or arbitrary-domain acceptance
design.variance_variance_estimator: mean squared deviation from analytic continuous variance mean; sample variance also reported
design.refinement_note: paired changes measure sensitivity, not the remaining bias; monotone noisy estimates are not required
